briefing.headline: Soft landing holds as growth steadies and inflation cools, held up by resilient work.

quotable_numbers.sentence: Core CPI at 2.6 percent for Sep 2026 edges nearer the Fed's target, easing rate pressure.
Unemployment at 4.1 percent for Oct 2026 strengthens to a four-month low, supporting growth.

briefing.whats_new: Today: 10-Year Treasury lower, from 5.15 percent to 5.12 percent.
